 "cells": [

   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "# Unit Thickness controlled\n",
    "\n",
    "This notebook presents a 3D synthetic model of ArchPy and demonstrate the capabilities to constrain units by thickness.\n",
    "\n",
    "No facies or property modeling here in order to keep the notebook short"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 1,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-04-01T08:36:02.195255Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-04-01T08:36:02.194246Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-04-01T08:36:04.122899Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-04-01T08:36:04.122899Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "import numpy as np\n",
    "import matplotlib\n",
    "from matplotlib import colors\n",
    "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
    "import geone\n",
    "import geone.covModel as gcm\n",
    "import geone.imgplot3d as imgplt3\n",
    "import pyvista as pv\n",
    "pv.set_jupyter_backend('static')\n",
    "import sys\n",
    "\n",
    "#For loading ArchPy, the path where ArchPy is must be added with sys\n",
    "sys.path.append(\"../../\")\n",
    "#my modules\n",
    "from ArchPy.base import * #ArchPy main functions \n",
    "from ArchPy.tpgs import * #Truncated plurigaussians"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "First defining necessary stratigraphic piles (same as in the 3D_archpy_example)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 2,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-04-01T08:36:04.124905Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-04-01T08:36:04.124905Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-04-01T08:36:04.127392Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-04-01T08:36:04.127392Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "PB = Pile(name = \"PB\",seed=1)\n",
    "P1 = Pile(name=\"P1\",seed=1)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "Dimensions of the grid"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 3,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-04-01T08:36:04.129395Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-04-01T08:36:04.128396Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-04-01T08:36:04.131362Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-04-01T08:36:04.131362Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "#grid\n",
    "sx = 1.5\n",
    "sy = 1.5\n",
    "sz = .15\n",
    "x1 = 20\n",
    "y1 = 10\n",
    "z1 = -6\n",
    "x0 = 0\n",
    "y0 = 0\n",
    "z0 = -15\n",
    "nx = 133\n",
    "ny = 67\n",
    "nz = 62\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "dimensions = (nx, ny, nz)\n",
    "spacing = (sx, sy, sz)\n",
    "origin = (x0, y0, z0)  "
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "The thickness constraint is defined here, when units are setup. To enforce a specific thickness to a unit, you can simply pass the key \"thickness\" to surface dictionary a particular unit and put the desired thickness as value"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Pile"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 4,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-04-01T08:36:04.132373Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-04-01T08:36:04.132373Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-04-01T08:36:04.138369Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-04-01T08:36:04.138369Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "Unit D: Surface added for interpolation\n",
      "Unit C: Surface added for interpolation\n",
      "Unit B: Surface added for interpolation\n",
      "Unit A: Surface added for interpolation\n",
      "Stratigraphic unit D added ✅\n",
      "Stratigraphic unit C added ✅\n",
      "Stratigraphic unit B added ✅\n",
      "Stratigraphic unit A added ✅\n",
      "Unit B3: Surface added for interpolation\n",
      "Unit B2: Surface added for interpolation\n",
      "Unit B1: Surface added for interpolation\n",
      "Stratigraphic unit B3 added ✅\n",
      "Stratigraphic unit B2 added ✅\n",
      "Stratigraphic unit B1 added ✅\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "#units covmodel\n",
    "covmodelD = gcm.CovModel2D(elem=[('cubic', {'w':0.6, 'r':[60,60]})])\n",
    "covmodelC = gcm.CovModel2D(elem=[('cubic', {'w':0.2, 'r':[80,80]})])\n",
    "covmodelB = gcm.CovModel2D(elem=[('cubic', {'w':0.6, 'r':[60,60]})])\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "#create Lithologies \n",
    "dic_s_D = {\"int_method\" : \"grf_ineq\",\"covmodel\" : covmodelD}\n",
    "dic_f_D = {\"f_method\":\"homogenous\"}\n",
    "D = Unit(name=\"D\",order=1,ID = 1,color=\"gold\",contact=\"onlap\",surface=Surface(contact=\"onlap\",dic_surf=dic_s_D)\n",
    "         ,dic_facies=dic_f_D)\n",
    "\n",
    "dic_s_C = {\"int_method\" : \"grf_ineq\",\"covmodel\" : covmodelC}\n",
    "dic_f_C = {\"f_method\":\"homogenous\"}\n",
    "C = Unit(name=\"C\",order=2,ID = 2,color=\"blue\",contact=\"onlap\",dic_facies=dic_f_C,surface=Surface(dic_surf=dic_s_C,contact=\"onlap\"))\n",
    "\n",
    "dic_s_B = {\"int_method\" : \"grf_ineq\",\"covmodel\" : covmodelB, \"thickness\":2}\n",
    "dic_f_B = {\"f_method\":\"SubPile\",\"SubPile\":PB}\n",
    "B = Unit(name=\"B\",order=3,ID = 3,color=\"green\",contact=\"onlap\",dic_facies=dic_f_B,surface=Surface(contact=\"onlap\",dic_surf=dic_s_B))\n",
    "\n",
    "dic_s_A = {\"int_method\":\"grf_ineq\",\"covmodel\": covmodelB}\n",
    "dic_f_A = {\"f_method\":\"homogenous\"}\n",
    "A = Unit(name=\"A\",order=5,ID = 5,color=\"red\",contact=\"onlap\",dic_facies=dic_f_A,surface=Surface(dic_surf = dic_s_A,contact=\"onlap\"))\n",
    "\n",
    "#Master pile\n",
    "P1.add_unit([D,C,B,A])\n",
    "\n",
    "# PB\n",
    "ds_B3 = {\"int_method\":\"grf_ineq\",\"covmodel\":covmodelB}\n",
    "df_B3 = {\"f_method\":\"homogenous\"}\n",
    "B3 = Unit(name = \"B3\",order=1,ID = 6,color=\"forestgreen\",surface=Surface(dic_surf=ds_B3,contact=\"onlap\"),dic_facies=df_B3)\n",
    "\n",
    "ds_B2 = {\"int_method\":\"grf_ineq\",\"covmodel\":covmodelB}\n",
    "df_B2 = {\"f_method\":\"homogenous\"}\n",
    "B2 = Unit(name = \"B2\",order=2,ID = 7,color=\"limegreen\",surface=Surface(dic_surf=ds_B2,contact=\"erode\"),dic_facies=df_B2)\n",
    "\n",
    "ds_B1 = {\"int_method\":\"grf_ineq\",\"covmodel\":covmodelB}\n",
    "df_B1 = {\"f_method\":\"homogenous\"}\n",
    "B1 = Unit(name = \"B1\",order=3, ID = 8,color=\"palegreen\",surface=Surface(dic_surf=ds_B1,contact=\"onlap\"),dic_facies=df_B1)\n",
    "\n",
    "## Subpile\n",
    "PB.add_unit([B3,B2,B1])"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 5,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-04-01T08:36:04.157523Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-04-01T08:36:04.157523Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-04-01T08:36:04.159874Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-04-01T08:36:04.159874Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "top = np.ones([ny,nx])*-6\n",
    "bot = np.ones([ny,nx])*z0"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Boreholes"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 6,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-04-01T08:36:04.160880Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-04-01T08:36:04.160880Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-04-01T08:36:04.165550Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-04-01T08:36:04.165550Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "#logs strati\n",
    "log_strati1 = [(C,-6.01),(B3,-8),(B2,-9),(B1,-9.5),(A,-10)]\n",
    "log_strati2 = [(C,-6.01),(B3,-8.5),(B2,-9.5),(A,-10.5)]\n",
    "log_strati3 = [(D,-6.01),(B3,-8),(B2,-8.5),(B1,-9.5),(A,-10.5)]\n",
    "log_strati4 = [(D,-6.01),(B3,-9),(B2,-10),(A,-11)]\n",
    "log_strati5 = [(D,-6.01),(C,-10),(A,-12)]\n",
    "log_strati6 = [(D,-6.01),(A,-9)]\n",
    "\n",
    "#create boreholes\n",
    "bh1 = borehole(\"b1\",1,x=10*1,y=10*5,z=log_strati1[0][1],depth =9,log_strati=log_strati1)\n",
    "bh2 = borehole(\"b2\",2,x=10*3,y=10*2,z=log_strati2[0][1],depth =8,log_strati=log_strati2)\n",
    "bh3 = borehole(\"b3\",3,x=10*5,y=10*6,z=log_strati3[0][1],depth =7,log_strati=log_strati3)\n",
    "bh4 = borehole(\"b4\",4,x=10*10,y=10*1,z=log_strati4[0][1],depth =8,log_strati=log_strati4)\n",
    "bh5 = borehole(\"b5\",5,x=10*15,y=10*3,z=log_strati5[0][1],depth =8,log_strati=log_strati5)\n",
    "bh6 = borehole(\"b6\",6,x=10*19,y=10*9,z=log_strati6[0][1],depth =6,log_strati=log_strati6)"
   ]
  },
  {

   "source": [
    "domain = np.ones([ny,nx],dtype=bool)\n",
    "domain[: 5]= 0\n",
    "domain[-5:] = 0\n",
    "plt.imshow(domain)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Table"

      "## Adding Grid ##\n",

      "Standard boreholes removed\n",

   "source": [
    "T1 = Arch_table(name = \"P1\",seed=1)\n",
    "T1.set_Pile_master(P1)\n",
    "T1.add_grid(dimensions, spacing, origin, top=top,bot=bot,polygon=domain)\n",
    "T1.rem_all_bhs()\n",
    "T1.add_bh([bh1,bh2,bh3,bh4,bh5,bh6])"
   ]

    "## Outputs"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "Checking the mean thickness of B unit.\n",
    "We can see that it is close to the given value of 2 m, except where boreholes indicate that this unit is absent. This highlights a contradiction between the concept of a 2 m thickness and the data, which show that the unit can sometimes be absent. ArchPy does not issue any warnings for this kind of issue, so it is up to the user to ensure that their model makes sense."
   ]
  },

   "cell_type": "markdown",

   "source": [
    "### Plotting units\n",
    "\n",
    "ArchPy integrates multiple plotting utilities that mostly rely on Pyvista and Geone.\n",
    "Below are some examples"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 14,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-04-01T08:36:06.946729Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-04-01T08:36:06.945733Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-04-01T08:36:07.613941Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-04-01T08:36:07.613941Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "image/jpeg": "",
      "image/png": "",
      "text/plain": [
       "<PIL.Image.Image image mode=RGB size=1024x768>"
      ]
     },
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "display_data"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "p = pv.Plotter()\n",
    "v_ex = 1\n",
    "\n",
    "T1.plot_units(0, v_ex=v_ex, plotter=p, slicex=(0.2, 0.5, 0.8), slicey=(0.2, 0.5, 0.8))\n",
    "T1.plot_bhs(plotter=p, v_ex=v_ex)\n",
    "p.show()"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "### Cross-sections\n",
    "\n",
    "ArchPy integrates the possibility to make cross-section, interactively or not.\n",
    "You can pass a list of point where to draw the cross-section. Boreholes are projected on the cross-section if they are at a distance less than ``dist_max``. You can choose which realization to plot with ``iu`` parameter. The width of the boreholes can be set with ``width`` parameter."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 15,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-04-01T08:36:07.615946Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-04-01T08:36:07.615946Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-04-01T08:36:07.734664Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-04-01T08:36:07.734664Z"
    },
    "tags": [
     "nbsphinx-thumbnail"
    ]
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "image/png": "",
      "text/plain": [
       "<Figure size 1000x1000 with 1 Axes>"
      ]
     },
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "display_data"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "#cross section\n",
    "#first a list of points must be defined\n",
    "p1 = [10,10]\n",
    "p2 = [50,70]\n",
    "p3 = [150,90]\n",
    "T1.plot_cross_section([p1,p2,p3],iu=5, ratio_aspect=2, dist_max=15, width=2, h_level=0, typ=\"units\")"
   ]
